entities.name: PMID:10736970
observations: Direct in-vitro study using cultured glomerular endothelial layers and gelatin-filter Boyden assays to measure monocyte migration.
Histamine increased migration; PGE2 and dibutyryl-cAMP inhibited migration; angiotensin II and endothelin-1 had no detectable effect under tested conditions.

entities.name: Histamine
observations: In cultured glomerular endothelial assays, increased monocyte passage dose-dependently; 10^-8 M increased filter migration from 16.6 ± 1.1 to 40.9 ± 0.9 monocytes/high-power field, and endothelial-layer passage from 1,012 ± 37 to 1,711 ± 163 cpm/well.
Cimetidine attenuated histamine-driven migration, supporting H2-receptor involvement.

entities.name: PGE2
observations: PGE2 inhibited monocyte migration dose-dependently across filters and glomerular endothelial layers, including basal and histamine-stimulated migration; it also attenuated IL-1beta-stimulated migration.

entities.name: Dibutyryl-cAMP
observations: Dibutyryl-cAMP attenuated basal, histamine-stimulated, and IL-1beta-stimulated monocyte migration across the glomerular endothelial layer.

entities.name: Angiotensin II
observations: No detectable modulation of monocyte migration in the reported glomerular endothelial assays.

entities.name: Endothelin-1
observations: No detectable modulation of monocyte migration in the reported glomerular endothelial assays.

entities.name: Glomerular endothelial cells
observations: Cultured glomerular endothelial layers served as an in-vitro model of monocyte entry toward the glomerular mesangium in PMID:10736970.
